newsitem.title: GERMANY: Drivers snooze after crash blocks German motorway.
newsitem.headline: Drivers snooze after crash blocks German motorway.

text.p: Thousands of motorists spent the night stranded in their cars in heavy snow on a busy northern German motorway after a truck jack-knifed and blocked traffic in both directions, police said on Tuesday.

Many drivers had fallen asleep in their cars and were blocking rescue vehicles from reaching the truck which had crashed through the central barrier, causing jams of more than than 100 km (60 miles) in both directions.
The truck driver was not hurt.
About six inches (15 cm) of snow had fallen in the night on the motorway. The Red Cross and firefighters brought hot tea and blankets to thousands of stranded motorists.
Police said the accident site was cleared early on Tuesday morning and traffic should return to normal by midday.
